notes.title: Huge Sale!
notes.content:
Greetings, dwarves of all clans!
I’m excited to let you know that we’re launching a discount—[b]a big one![/b]
Since the release, I’ve been hard at work adding a bunch of exciting updates myself, and I really hope you’ll enjoy the game and have a great time with it.
And if you feel like it, maybe leave a comment or a review?
Have fun!

notes.title: NodeLord 1.6
notes.content:
Hey!

A really cool update just dropped, introducing the ability to rotate buildings. You can do this by pressing the 'R' key while building.

This will allow for a better organization of the entire production process.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492306/88dac434ff7d74af5ad50556ef5191df74df020a.png[/img]

notes.title: NodeLord 1.5.4
notes.content:
Hi!
A small update:
I’ve implemented some tweaks, optimizations, and a few balance changes. Additionally, I’ve decided to remove analytics from the project. It provided valuable insights that allowed me to make some great updates, but its role ends here. Feel free to share your ideas and thoughts. Have fun!

notes.title: NodeLord 1.5
notes.content:
Hi! The update introduces a new enemy type, the [b]Troll Shaman[/b]. It's quite slow and weak but possesses an extraordinary ability - it heals other trolls! Additionally, it is immune to bleeding and fear.
Moreover, I have fixed a few bugs, including the game continuation retaining the selected game mode properly, and one of the maps that wasn't spawning enemies has been fixed.
Have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492306/3d64bbc3cd9dc7be2a14270480bd442647614704.png[/img]

notes.title: NodeLord 1.4
notes.content:
Hi!
Version 1.4 has just been released;
it includes a new building - the [b]distributor[/b].
Its operation is simple - resources first go to the priority slot. If the priority slot is full, resources are directed to the non-priority slot. You can change the priority by clicking on the building.
Below, in the image, there is a simple setup that ensures the tower has priority in receiving wood as ammunition during a troll attack, and during peacetime, the wood will be used to produce planks.
I think this is something everyone has been missing, and it will greatly enhance the gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492306/d57661f24cb2120f9a98bb3aa3fb27c75eedb15b.png[/img]

notes.title: NodeLord 1.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone! An update has been released that introduces the creation of poisons from troll corpses and water. The poison deals damage over time. Additionally, torches can now set enemy units on fire! Below is a screenshot showing how to obtain these items. Also, some ammunition now has its own unique sounds. Have fun playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492306/ed93bedbe2ef7a77df300778a8f1550cba882700.png[/img]

notes.title: NodeLord 1.2
notes.content:
Hello! As promised, here's the next update! It introduces 3 important things:

[/list]

notes.title: NodeLord 1.1
notes.content:
Hi there! Version 1.1 has just been released, and along with it:
[list]
[*] New recipes and items

[/list]

notes.title: Changes in the behavior of enemy units (AI)
notes.content:
Hi there! Over the past few days, I've been completely overhauling the AI opponents, and it seems like they're in a good state now.

Here's how it works now:

[list]
[*]Clusters of buildings are identified. Those with houses are rated better—trolls can smell dwarves!
[*]If a troll doesn't see anything interesting (trolls have a field of view and react accordingly), it heads towards the best cluster of buildings.
[*]If a building is within a troll's field of view, the troll will attack it.
[*]If a wall is within a troll's field of view, the troll will attack it.
[*]If a troll sees a building but a wall blocks its path, it will try to go around it. If there's no gap in the wall within its field of view, it will destroy the wall first.
[/list]

This should make troll behavior a bit more predictable and enjoyable. No more searching for a gap in the wall from the other end of the map!

I hope you'll enjoy playing with these changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492306/9cdc70613e31eb970ce13bbba41d1ccea979a1fc.png[/img]

notes.title: Small Update (1.0.1)
notes.content:
Hey! I've released a minor update that includes:
- Pausing time until the construction of the first building is complete.
- Improved visibility of the status of output slots (it will be clearer whether we're currently discovering the recipe or not).
- Changes related to the reset key and reset confirmation.

notes.title: Important Announcement
notes.content:
Hello! I hope you're having a great time playing the game!

I've received reports about issues with the AI - I plan to investigate them as a top priority.
Additionally, I've identified a few minor things that, when fixed, should enhance the overall gaming experience.

However, [b]I need your help![/b] Share your feedback, report any aspects of the game that bother you, and let me know!
[b]Feel free to join our Discord for discussions, and participate in the conversation on Steam![/b]
Together, we can make NodeLord an outstanding game!

notes.title: Game modes and quality improvement
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

I wanted to quickly give you a glimpse into the progress of development. Currently, I'm focused on adjusting the balance, fixing bugs, and making sure the game runs even smoother. Throughout these efforts, I'm also mindful of adding fresh content, so you have something extra to explore.

The major announcement: intensive work is underway on two new game modes – [b]endless[/b] and [b]sandbox[/b]. I hope they will add a new dynamic to your gaming experience.

Thanks for your support and understanding! Stay tuned, as soon you'll be able to dive into new possibilities in the game!

notes.title: Time for New Challenges in Nodelord Game!
notes.content:
I present to you the latest updates in the Nodelord game! I've been working on adding a few key elements. Here are a few of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492306/1a857b7ca4376d66c2a480e5c9fdb93359f9fc48.png[/img]
[b]Diverse Maps[/b]
Now you can explore diverse maps with unique features and terrains. Each map has its strengths and weaknesses, so you must adapt your strategy to the specific situation. Are you ready to face new challenges?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492306/4109af72531f5f44c94e2373281a1683feb07bd1.png[/img]
[b]Starting Bonuses[/b]
Now you have the option to choose starting bonuses that will impact the development of your settlement. Decide in which direction you want your settlement to grow and tailor your strategy to your preferences.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492306/337f9b68677298e9b060a9c1feb313d0c9a2e8d8.png[/img]
[b]Fortify Your Settlement[/b]
Not only survive but also fortify your settlement using walls, battlements, and palisades. Now you can protect key areas from troll invasions and increase your chances of victory.


Stay tuned for more updates and surprises in the future.
